notablePrerequisites: Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, targeting Garth One-Eye.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, targeting Pili-Pala.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untap it, adding {U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, targeting Garth One-Eye.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Repeat from step 6.
